Operation 𝐄𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐜 𝐎𝐮𝐭𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐭 targets six components of Hizballah’s support infrastructure: a charity used to conceal militant activity and divert donor funding, and a Lebanon–Türkiye gold and cash-smuggling network transferring IRGC-QF funds to Hizballah.

Individuals
- 𝐀𝐟𝐢𝐟 𝐀𝐛𝐝𝐞𝐥 𝐑𝐢𝐝𝐚 𝐂𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧 — Lebanon; founder and leader of Wa Ta’awanu who coordinates the charity’s activities at Hizballah’s direction.
- 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐧 𝐊𝐡𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐧 — Lebanese businessman and money changer; operates a cross-border gold and cash network that transfers IRGC-QF funds to Lebanon for Hizballah. Owns Gold Global Company and controls Sankari Gold.
- 𝐈𝐛𝐫𝐚𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐊𝐡𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐧 — Lebanon; participates in his brother Hassan’s Hizballah money-smuggling network. Linked to a courier arrested at Beirut airport in February 2025 carrying $2.5 million in hand luggage.

Entities
- 𝐖𝐚 𝐓𝐚’𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐮 𝐀𝐬𝐬𝐨𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 — Lebanon; Hizballah-affiliated charity ostensibly providing emergency relief in southern Lebanon while channeling external donations toward terrorist activities. Its presence also provides cover for Hizballah militant activity in pilot zones and obstructs Lebanese disarmament efforts.
- 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐆𝐥𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐧𝐲 — Lebanon; Hassan Khechen-owned company used to move funds through multiple transit countries into Lebanon for Hizballah.
- 𝐒𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚𝐫𝐢 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐊𝐮𝐲𝐮𝐦𝐜𝐮𝐥𝐮𝐤 𝐓𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐭 𝐋𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐒𝐢𝐫𝐤𝐞𝐭𝐢 — Türkiye; Hizballah-affiliated, Hassan Khechen-controlled company assisting Gold Global Company with movements of African-origin gold bullion and cash.

Network and geopolitical significance
- The network employs couriers and gold-trading channels to move cash across borders and transfer substantial IRGC-QF funding to Hizballah.
- The action seeks to disrupt Iran’s financial support to Hizballah and expose the group’s exploitation of humanitarian organizations amid international pressure for its disarmament.
- Wa Ta’awanu allegedly undermines implementation of the June 26, 2026 U.S.–Lebanon–Israel Trilateral Framework by providing a pretext for Hizballah activity in areas secured by the Lebanese Armed Forces.

Sanctions authority and implications
- All targets were designated under E.O. 13224, as amended, for supporting Hizballah or for being owned, controlled, or directed by Hassan Khechen.
- U.S.-linked property and interests in property are blocked and must be reported to OFAC; entities owned 50 percent or more by blocked persons are also blocked.
- U.S. persons generally may not transact with the targets absent authorization or exemption.
- Foreign financial institutions facilitating significant transactions for the designated persons may face secondary sanctions, including restrictions on U.S. correspondent or payable-through accounts.
- OFAC may impose civil penalties on a strict-liability basis; sanctions evasion or causing U.S. persons to violate sanctions is also prohibited.

Source: https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sb0692/

The Israeli Air Force and Hellenic Air Force wrapped up a joint aerial refueling drill earlier this week over Greece, the IDF announces.

As part of the exercise on Monday, the military says the IAF's 120th Squadron practiced aerial refueling of fighter jets "for long-range missions."

"The exercise lasted several hours, during which fighter jets joined up with refueling aircraft and were refueled midair so they could continue their missions," the IDF says.

The IAF and HAF conduct regular joint drills.

"The exercise was held as part of the Israeli Air Force’s annual training program and enables mutual learning, strengthens operational readiness, and deepens cooperation between the air forces," the military adds.

رافائل گروسی، مدیرکل آژانس بین‌المللی انرژی اتمی، روز چهارشنبه ۲۷ آبان اعلام کرد که این نهاد، به‌استثنای نیروگاه هسته‌ای بوشهر، نه اطلاعاتی از ایران درباره وضعیت مواد و تأسیسات هسته‌ای اعلام‌شده دریافت کرده و نه به این تأسیسات برای انجام بازرسی و راستی‌آزمایی میدانی دسترسی داشته است.

او تأکید کرد تا زمانی که ایران اطلاعات لازم درباره وضعیت مواد و تأسیسات هسته‌ای اعلام‌شده خود را در اختیار آژانس نگذارد و امکان دسترسی بازرسان برای انجام راستی‌آزمایی میدانی فراهم نشود، این نهاد قادر نخواهد بود نتیجه‌گیری کند که هیچ‌یک از مواد هسته‌ای اعلام‌شده از فعالیت‌های صلح‌آمیز منحرف نشده است.

פרטים נוספים על פגישת בנט-נתניהו:

דקות לפני שהחלה הפגישה עם בנט - נתניהו נפגש עם גדעון סער (שמבין גם בענייני ביטחון וגם בעניינים אחרים) בלשכת רה״מ בכנסת.

בתחילת הפגישה לא נכח בחדר גורם ביטחוני ורק כרבע שעה לאחמ״כ נכנס ראש המל״ל איש אמונו של נתניהו.

כחצי שעה לאחר שהחלה הצטרף גם המזכ״צ.

ככה לא נראה עדכון ביטחוני סטנדרטי.

English

More details on the Bennett-Netanyahu meeting:

Minutes before the meeting with Bennett began, Netanyahu met with Gideon Sa’ar (who also understands security matters as well as other matters) in the Prime Minister’s Office at the Knesset.

At the beginning of the meeting, no security official was present in the room, and only about 15 minutes later did the head of the National Security Council, a Netanyahu confidant, enter.

About half an hour after it began, the military secretary also joined.

This is not what a standard security briefing looks like.


ترجمه خودکار فارسی

جزئیات بیشتر درباره دیدار بنت و نتانیاهو:

دقایقی پیش از آغاز دیدار با بنت، نتانیاهو در دفتر نخست‌وزیر در کنست با گیدعون ساعر (که هم در مسائل امنیتی و هم در امور دیگر سررشته دارد) دیدار کرد.

در آغاز دیدار هیچ مقام امنیتی در اتاق حضور نداشت و تنها حدود یک ربع بعد، رئیس شورای امنیت ملی که از معتمدان نتانیاهو است، وارد شد.

حدود نیم ساعت پس از آغاز دیدار، دبیر نظامی نیز به آن‌ها پیوست.

یک جلسه توجیهی امنیتی معمول، این‌طور نیست.

Ben Tzion Macales ✓ @BenTzionMacales

During a review of satellite imagery of Iran's Esfahan Province, I identified a previously undisclosed underground facility of unusually large scale, located approximately 50 km north of the city of Esfahan

The facility is located within a strategically significant location near the main highway connecting Tehran and Esfahan.

The complex features five tunnel entrances, divided into two sections.
Construction began in January 2026, with activity accelerating following Operation Epic Fury.

At this stage, it remains unclear what its intended purpose might be.

The sheer scale of the construction activity makes the site's development clearly visible even in Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, despite its relatively low spatial resolution.
